## Batch 69 handoff

I authored the assigned pair, three local definitions/results, three examples/counterexamples, and the batch evidence. All nine Step 1 records are **escalated**, not ready.

- The weak-base lemma’s step 5.1 does not fully derive the two target-base unit identities. The relative-tensor proposition uses them for unit-map H-linearity in step 3.1. Schauenburg’s base-algebra proof does not supply those exact calculations, and Böhm–Caenepeel–Janssen note omitted calculations in their unit proof ([Schauenburg](https://www.impan.pl/shop/publication/transaction/download/product/86703), [Böhm–Caenepeel–Janssen](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1103.2261)). The notes propose an A-page supplier and record the affected claims.
- The batch 64 reading prerequisite is still not ready. The live run also reports a scaffold blocker: malformed JSON at line 129, column 2. The shared batch-dependency schedule is stale after manifest authoring; I left it unchanged for the owner to recompute.

Scoped checks passed: precheck 6/6 proof-bearing items, proof-layout 9 items / 30 steps / 0 defects, rendercheck 11 files, focused depcheck and content-policy with 0 errors, strict contracts 6/6, item levels 9 items / 0 errors, and source fetch 5/5.

The Step 1 records were written with `owner:false`. Later proof edits mean their stored hashes and some reason text reflect earlier drafts; the notes record the exact transcription and step-reference corrections. I did not overwrite those escalations.
